1.consolidated_definition: inform. Disco rígido no removible de la computadora, importante para su funcionamiento. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Todo esta conectado a un sistema que permite grabar en hard drive (audio y video), CD o en cassette y se combina con una cámara controlada remotamente (Centro Unido de Detallistas, consultado 30-06-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Inform. A non-removable hard drive of the computer, essential for its operation. This system is connected to a unit that allows recording on a hard drive (audio and video), CD, or cassette, and combines with a remotely controlled camera (Unified Center of Retailers, consulted 30-06-08).
